label: Change of state; impressed force: ChangesState x: body x changes its state of rest or of uniform…
term: change of state; impressed force (Newton, Lex I)
definition: `ChangesState x`: body x changes its state of rest or of uniform motion in a straight line. `ImpressesForceOn y x`: y impresses a force on x (vis impressa). Newton's vocabulary, not identified with `MovedIn` or `MovesIn`; whether a state of uniform motion is a being moved is the reading question of DISAMB-MOTION.
